column1: # layout-compare, 2026-10-16T02:20:04 to 2026-10-16T09:00:56: hybrid-run.sh in /Users/cp1/.local/state/visionocr-autonomous/ocrlab/layout, tools from ef91b9d (149 runs; the heron-falcon s47 retry from a370d11, which changed nothing under Sources), the 15 pages of
# ops/ocrlab/layout-sample.tsv (the 11 newspaper pages of OCR-SAMPLE-2026-10-04.tsv, and C41's four other whole-page scans
# c01-c04, which have no truth transcript, so they are published and counted in `pages`/`ok` and `unscored`, not in the word
# counts), each published by score-gate and scored by ux-harness --truth; made by layout-table.py over hybrid-table.py
# (column meanings in its docstring). Each combination is one layout detector's regions read by one reader; the
# regions arrangement aligns the reader's words onto Vision's lines (Recogniser.regionAligned), so what differs between
# detectors is which lines get a model's words. vision-off is Vision alone on the same pages, the baseline wm_cut is against.
# Detectors (layout-regions.py, then dedupe-regions.py and reader-regions.sh's 2 px filter for all three alike):

#   yolo: DocLayout-YOLO DocStructBench, juliozhao/DocLayout-YOLO-DocStructBench as the app's Core ML model (72 MB installed, a 64.8 MB archive); the lab's ONNX build wybxc/DocLayout-YOLO-DocStructBench-onnx (71 MB) is the same net, boxes within 0.0002 px; licence Apache-2.0 (the weights' card; DocLayout-YOLO's code is AGPL-3.0, which the app neither ships nor runs); conf 0.25; reading order none: the app's column sort; fit test over 15 pages: detect 0.51 s a page on the CPU, peak RSS 1241 MB, ink in text regions 0.858

#   pp: PP-DocLayoutV3, PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (133 MB) converted to MLX float32 (128 MB), mlx-vlm's pp_doclayout_v3; licence Apache-2.0; conf 0.3; reading order the model's own; fit test over 15 pages: detect 0.47 s a page on the CPU, peak RSS 794 MB, ink in text regions 0.861

#   heron: docling-layout-heron, ds4sd/docling-layout-heron (RT-DETRv2, 42.9M parameters, 164 MB safetensors) through transformers and torch; no MLX or Core ML build exists, so it needs a torch runtime the app does not ship; licence Apache-2.0; conf 0.3; reading order none: the app's column sort; fit test over 15 pages: detect 0.41 s a page on the CPU, peak RSS 1439 MB, ink in text regions 0.945
# download_MB is the weights alone. PP and YOLO run in the lab's MLX/onnxruntime venv (the app runs YOLO through Core ML);
# heron needs torch and transformers (the lab's venv-surya), a runtime of its own. fit_* and ink_covered are from
# layout-fit.sh on 300 dpi renders (LAYOUT-COMPARE-*-fit.tsv), the detector alone, each page a fresh process; peak_mb is
# the guard's sample of the reader's processes during the job. On the *-vision rows that reader is the detector alone,
# done in seconds, which the guard's 2 s sample mostly missed (2 MB on most pages, as OCR-COMPARE-2026-10-13 noted):
# fit_peak_mb is the detector's own peak. A run moved out of H/runs (runs-superseded/) is not in these tables.

# heron-falcon s47's first run failed at the app's 600 s reader bound (Falcon-OCR looping on one of heron's 42 regions; 1,206 s, two tries); run again alone an hour later it read in 64.4 s and that run is the row here. The first attempt is in runs-superseded/heron-falcon-s47-attempt1.
